checks.name: Desktop page loads five labels and the recognition workspace
Model selector reflects loaded models and the hash-gated default with five public labels
All four tabs expose the matching labelled panel
Tab list supports ArrowRight and Home keyboard navigation
MP4 sample preview decodes in the real browser
Invalid crop is explained before a video request is sent
Actual sample bytes are processed by MediaPipe and the TCN; result is shown
Native HTML validation rejects invalid signer and session codes
A prediction-backed annotation is saved once and its training replay is identified
CSV download preserves the server prediction and Unicode label
Changing the model invalidates the previous result for annotation
File upload uses actual video and crop changes invalidate the result
An older in-flight response cannot enable annotation after configuration changes
Actual six-output candidate rejects an existing outside replay without showing its internal class token
Outside replay annotation keeps the raw decision and is counted as training replay for this model
Matched source-excluded comparison is shown separately from historical v5 full-fit probes
Synthetic browser media records real WebM, stops tracks and processes a rejection
Rejected no-hand capture can be annotated and counted in outside denominators
All four views fit a 390px mobile viewport without horizontal page overflow
Injected camera permission denial is explained and recording remains disabled
Real page has no uncaught JavaScript, CSP or invalid HTML pattern errors
Only an isolated annotation log remains; raw uploads are not retained

limitations: Headless Linux browser; this does not test the user's physical webcam, Windows installation or mobile device hardware.
A prerecorded training video verifies software flow, not independent recognition accuracy.
Camera capture uses a synthetic source (native fake device when supported, otherwise an injected canvas MediaStream); permission denial is injected explicitly.
